limits: Matched rear starting weights, data, cache and actual update schedule. Weighted losses have different meanings; compare unweighted fixed validation and physical onset errors. Onset metrics use trained histories. Autonomous seeds identify matched opportunities, not exact simulator replay. Four development starts per role/arm do not establish robust success or a general A/B mechanism advantage.
